title: Jake Barber's orbs phasing into mountains over the range

tellings.quote: Didn't Jake Barber talk about some of the like light orbs or weird non really physically identifiable craft he'd see over the range would like almost phase into mountains

plain: Over his test range in California, Jake Barber, a former special operations pilot who says he took part in recovering non-human craft, is said to have seen glowing orbs of light and strange craft that seemed to "almost phase into mountains", as if passing into solid rock. An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb (from UAP, the official term for unidentified flying objects) brings this up on the show as something he remembers Barber describing. It would mean the objects are not ordinary physical machines.
